description: Durable SQLite event store with WAL mode

requirements.title: SQLite WAL mode storage
requirements.description: Events stored in SQLite with WAL mode, busy_timeout=10000, synchronous=NORMAL

requirements.title: Event schema
requirements.description: Events table with id (autoincrement), event_id (unique), source_scenario, target_scenario, event_type, correlation_id, payload (BLOB), metadata (JSON), created_at

requirements.title: Dual-trigger pruning
requirements.description: Background goroutine at configurable interval (default: every 6 hours) deletes events older than retention window (default: 30 days) or when total size exceeds size cap (default: 2GB). Currently hardcoded — see REQ-ES-004 for configurable version.

requirements.title: Configurable retention settings
requirements.description: Retention window, size cap, and prune interval stored in SQLite settings table. Changeable via API (PUT /api/v1/settings/retention) and UI. Changes take effect on next prune cycle. Settings: retention_days (int, default 30), max_size_bytes (int, default 2147483648), prune_interval_hours (int, default 6). Manual prune trigger via POST /api/v1/settings/retention/prune.
